title: That's Tuff
description: Adds more tuffs variants to the game because that's TUFF !!!
body:
# THAT'S TUFF
Did you want to have more tuff block variants to build with ??
No worry **THAT'S TUFF** is HERE !

![Mossy Tuff Blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b1576e4076d8108edcf953a456238b84d21a48f1.png)

![Mossy Tuff Stairs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1ba220a88a5ab81a2a7ea7dfb5c93f125e6e749a.png)

![Mossy Tuff Slabs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ac0830454f334ec25481a98f4888385743a625a3.png)

![Mossy Tuff Walls](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2ee019c7ea42e5f69253e1c5f91a97a691986d72.png)

### Can work with the Tricky Trials mod for better experience, you can download it [here](https://modrinth.com/mod/1.21-update).
